name: Blood Pressure
spaceEffect: Fluid cephalad shift increases central arterial pressure initially, followed by baroreflex resets.

name: Heart Rate
spaceEffect: Cardiovascular deconditioning and autonomic alterations can trigger sinus tachycardia or arrhythmias.

name: Blood Glucose
spaceEffect: Microgravity insulin resistance alterations and metabolic shifts under chronic mission stress.

name: Body Temperature
spaceEffect: Spaceflight-associated core temperature elevation ('space fever') during exercise and resting cycles.

name: Sleep Duration
spaceEffect: Circadian desynchrony due to 90-minute orbital lighting cycles or deep-space confinement.

name: Cognitive & Mood Score
spaceEffect: Sensory deprivation, isolation from Earth, high workload, and mission communication delays.
